title: RS_Min_Agg
description: An aggregate function that computes the pixel-wise minimum across a group of rasters.
kernels:
  - returns: raster
    args: [raster]
---

## Description

An aggregate function that computes the pixel-wise minimum raster across all rasters in a group. Every raster
in a group must share the same band count, dimension names, shape, data type, and nodata value.

A pixel equal to a band's nodata value is treated as absent rather than as a comparable number: the other
raster's value wins outright, and a pixel that is nodata in every raster in the group stays nodata.

## Examples

```sql
SELECT RS_Min_Agg(raster) FROM (
    VALUES
        (RS_Example()),
        (RS_Example())
) AS t(raster);
```
